examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Default label without the required indicator.

examples.name: Required
examples.summary: Required label — appends the inline `* (Required)` indicator.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Label from '@aziontech/webkit/label'
</script>

<template>
  <Label
    label="Label"
    required
  />
</template>

examples.name: Hinted
examples.summary: Hinted label — `hint` appends a Hint glyph after the text. Hover or focus it to read the explanation.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Label from '@aziontech/webkit/label'
</script>

<template>
  <Label
    label="Sensitive"
    hint="Values are encrypted at rest and never displayed again after saving."
  />
</template>
